newsitem.title: USA: Daschle - passage of budget amendment very close.
newsitem.headline: Daschle - passage of budget amendment very close.

text.p: Democratic Leader Tom Daschle said Wednesday the outlook for Senate passage of a balanced budget amendment to the U.S. constitution hinged on a handful of undecided votes.
"The vote hangs in the balance. If the vote were taken today, there's more than a likelihood that Republicans would win it," Daschle told reporters.
But he added in the days remaining before the amendment came to a Senate vote, Democrats would work to round up the needed senators to defeat it.
"We're shooting with real bullets here," Daschle said.
"This is going to come down to a vote or two on either side," he said.

Daschle released a new letter from President Clinton reiterating his opposition to the amendment and warning it could have the unintended effect of halting Social Security checks in the event of any future budget impasse.
